ideas.pitch: Emergency offline disaster communication bridge using ESP32, LoRa, and BLE mesh for areas with down cellular infrastructure.
ideas.problem_statement: Defence and disaster response hardware communication resilience during blackouts.
ideas.title: MeshComm Field Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of the Nepal Police Hackathon winner by building a robust, low-cost decentralized mesh device that solves a critical local emergency scenario.

ideas.pitch: A biomedical IoT system for continuous post-operative patient vital sign monitoring with real-time edge anomaly alerts.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare monitoring systems for rural or remote post-operative recovery tracking.
ideas.title: BioEdge Post-Op Telemetry Unit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the HardHack winning project by combining edge computing telemetry with actionable predictive health alerts that directly appeal to medical and engineering judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated conveyor belt sorting module powered by computer vision and microcontrollers to segregate industrial scrap material.
ideas.problem_statement: Industrial automation and sustainable manufacturing waste management.
ideas.title: AutoSort Industrial Waste Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the TechnoMorph runner-up pattern by delivering a working physical demo with a live sensor-to-actuator control loop instead of just a software simulation.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent hardware relay monitor that detects line anomalies and isolates electrical grid faults instantly at the edge.
ideas.problem_statement: Energy distribution networks and electrical grid safety automation.
ideas.title: GridPulse Substation Fault Isolation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the electrical engineering department's core focus at FCRIT by showcasing power system protection logic implemented on physical hardware.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-enabled smart locking and telemetry module designed for localized campus electric bicycle sharing networks.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart campus mobility and sustainable intra-city transport infrastructure.
ideas.title: SmartLock BikeFleet Station
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the BoilerMake Grand Prize winning architecture by integrating secure hardware locking mechanisms with cloud telemetry and instant user verification.
